project_type: React SPA with Vite + TypeScript, Arabic RTL educational platform
build_system: Vite 5 with TypeScript 5.7, workspace monorepo (root package.json with workspaces)
test_framework: No test framework installed - visual validation only
build_command: Cannot run build - node_modules not installed and INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network prevents npm install. Validate via reading/checking TypeScript syntax manually.
test_command: No tests available - validate by ensuring CSS/TSX files are syntactically correct
verification_instructions: Since no node_modules and no network: 1) Check CSS files for syntax errors, 2) Ensure TSX files maintain valid JSX, 3) Confirm all imports reference existing modules, 4) Verify RTL attributes preserved
setup_instructions: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY mode - no npm install possible. Work directly with source files.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external downloads. node_modules does NOT exist. Cannot run build/dev/typecheck commands. All validation must be AST/syntax-level by reading files. Pre-installed: Node 22.22.3.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality, routing, business logic, backend integration, user roles, RTL support. Only visual/CSS changes and component template changes allowed.
key_patterns: CSS layers loaded in order in main.tsx: tokens -> stitch-tokens -> base -> components -> utilities -> landing -> premium -> system -> responsive -> dashboard -> interactions -> notifications -> polish -> redesign-v2 -> landing-auth-v3 -> stitch-canonical -> pdf. Later files override earlier. Components use BEM-like class names. Primitives in components/primitives/index.tsx (Card, MetricCard, Badge, ProgressBar, etc). Layout in components/layout/ (AppShell, Sidebar, Topbar, BottomNav). Reveal animations via useReveal hook. Design tokens as CSS custom properties in tokens.css with overrides in stitch-tokens.css and stitch-canonical.css.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - 17 CSS files loaded in cascade order. frontend/src/components/ - shared UI (layout/, primitives/, Icon, BrandMark, EmojiIcon). frontend/src/pages/ - route pages organized by role (student/, teacher/, admin/, quality/, vision/, community/, exams/). frontend/src/hooks/ - useAuth, useResources, useReveal. frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores. frontend/src/lib/ - query client, nav config, utils.
